claim_boundaries: Q15 comparison estimates a difference between complete frozen source-only pipelines, not an isolated causal parameter-sharing effect.
Internal benchmark development remains exploratory and duration rescue does not constitute a general typical-person benefit.
Q15 primary family covers exactly Cho and Lee; PhysioNet and internal hypotheses retain separate procedures.
Bootstrap intervals are unadjusted, participant conditional, and not source-cohort or development-history uncertainty.
Raw-to-prediction replay is attributed to the completed cloud scientific validator; this review performs no raw EEG loading, checkpoint deserialization, new fitting or inference.
Unknown native voltage calibration, original Cho reference, event-index convention and hardware cue latency remain disclosed.
Public raw datasets do not substitute for author institutional-secondary-analysis confirmation; ethics identifiers, competing interests or funding are not fabricated.
